title: Fourier Restriction Beyond Dimension Data: A Multiscale Moment Criterion
summary: We establish an exact Fourier restriction criterion for a class of weighted Moran measures. Assuming uniformly bounded one-level frame bounds, we prove that, for every \(s>2\), the measure itself already detects the full extension estimate: \(L^2(μ)\to L^s(\mathbb R)\) extension holds if and only if \(\widehatμ\in L^s(\mathbb R)\), equivalently, if and only if the one-level Fourier moments \(G_{s,n}\) are summable, where $G_{s,n}$ is the $s$th moment of the nonzero Fourier coefficients of the $n$th digit law.
